messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

function.name: movie_details_brief
function.description: This function retrieves a brief about a specified movie. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

extra_info.description: Option to get additional information like Director, Cast, Awards etc.

message.reasoning:
The user wants a brief about the movie "全面啟動" (which is "Inception") and then retrieve extra info about Inception (director, cast, awards) and also about another movie "黑暗騎士" ("The Dark Knight"). The function movie_details_brief can retrieve details for a specified movie title. It has an optional parameter extra_info. We need to call it twice: once for Inception with extra_info true, and once for The Dark Knight with extra_info true.

We should first provide a brief about Inception. Then we need to retrieve extra info for both movies. The function only accepts one movie at a time. So we will call it twice. The user wants the brief first, then the extra info for both movies. We can do the brief manually or via function? The brief can be manually written. But maybe better to use function for brief too? The function returns brief if extra_info false. But we want brief plus extra info separately. The user specifically says "provide a brief about the movie, then retrieve extra info". So we can give a manual brief, then call function for each with extra_info true.

Thus output: brief text, then function calls. We'll produce the brief as plain text. Then two function calls. Use the function name movie_details_brief. Provide title and extra_info true. For Inception: title "Inception". For The Dark Knight: title "The Dark Knight".

Return JSON calls.
